description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM models for a personal finance tracker application, defining classes such as User, Transaction, Category, Budget, and Audit, which map to database tables and include their fields and relationships.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user of the finance tracker, including personal details, account creation time, and relationships to transactions, budgets, and audits.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Categorizes transactions; linked to a user and records related transactions.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Records a financial transaction, including amount, description, date, receipt URL, type (income or expense), and relationships to user and category.

classes.name: Budget
classes.description: Represents a user-defined budget for a category over a specific period.

classes.name: Audit
classes.description: Logs actions performed by users for auditing purposes, with details and timestamps.
